description: This routine is designed to address hyperpigmentation by utilizing ingredients known for their skin-lightening and brightening properties. It includes both morning and night steps, as well as a weekly treatment to enhance results.

morning_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and prep the skin for treatment
Boost collagen production, brighten skin tone, and inhibit melanin formation

morning_steps.action: Apply a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher
morning_steps.purpose: Protect the skin from UV damage which can exacerbate hyperpigmentation

night_steps.purpose: Promote cell turnover, improve texture and tone

night_steps.action: Moisturize with an hyaluronic acid cream
night_steps.purpose: Hydrate the skin for optimal absorption of other treatments

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate with a chemical peel or gentle scrub

expected_results.2_weeks: Visible reduction in dark spots and a more even skin tone
expected_results.1_month: Significant improvement in hyperpigmentation, brighter complexion
expected_results.3_months: Substantially clearer skin with minimized signs of hyperpigmentation

expert_tips: Patch test new products before full application
Stay hydrated and maintain a balanced diet
